claims.text: The wait is there because the tax vendor rate-limits us. It returns a 429 if two requests from the same account land within 3 seconds, and their support confirmed there is no burst allowance.

citations.quote: The vendor returns 429 if two requests from the same account land within 3 seconds, and their support confirmed there is no burst allowance.

claims.text: Without the delay the nightly batch loses about 8% of quotes. I called it a hack when I wrote it, and I noted that the proper fix is a queue.

citations.quote: Without the delay the nightly batch loses about 8% of quotes. Proper fix is a queue.

claims.text: Tom later renamed the variables and pulled the 3000 into PAUSE_MS. He also left a TODO saying the delay can go away after migrating to the new tax vendor.

claims.text: The delay is probably tied to the old vendor's limit, so it may be removable after the migration. I can't tell from the ledger whether the new vendor has the same limit, or whether the migration has happened.
